svg.text: SVG ini mengikuti isi Docs/class-diagram.mmd: Models, Views, Controllers/Data, relasi MVC, inheritance, polymorphism, interface, dan abstraction.
Inheritance: Form <|-- BaseForm, BaseForm <|-- MainForm, Form <|-- LoginForm, UserControl <|-- setiap View modul, Button <|-- PrimaryButton.
Abstraction/Interface: IDisplayableModel <|.. MasterDataEntity; MasterDataEntity <|-- Supplier, Destination, CoffeeType, CoffeeProduct, CoffeeOrigin, RoastLevel.
MVC: Program membuat LoginForm/LoginController dan MainForm/MainController. Controller menyimpan referensi View, menerima event View, lalu mengisi Model dari database.
Controller ke Model: UserManagementController memakai User dan Role; DataManagementController memakai Supplier, Destination, CoffeeProduct, CoffeeType, CoffeeCategory, CoffeeOrigin, RoastLevel.
Transaksi/Laporan: PenerimaanController memakai DropdownItem dan LaporanPenerimaanItem; PengirimanController memakai DropdownItem dan LaporanPengirimanItem; LaporanController memakai item laporan.

Database: LoginController, UserManagementController, DataManagementController, AdminDashboardController, PetugasDashboardController, PenerimaanController, PengirimanController, dan LaporanController memakai DatabaseHelper.
Polymorphism: PrimaryButton override OnMouseEnter/OnMouseLeave; model turunan MasterDataEntity override GetDisplayName() dengan perilaku berbeda per class.
Encapsulation: field private/readonly di View dan Controller, serta property model membungkus data domain.
